review:
Grand Buffalo Hold and Win is a Trueways western slot with buffalo, multiplier wilds and a progressive route to its top jackpot. Every scatter that lands fills a badge beside the reels, and once the badge is full it changes colour, unlocking a chance at the Mega jackpot in Coin Respin.

Coin Respin offers three jackpots, and Lightning symbols can expand the feature. BGaming rates it high volatility with a 5,000x maximum and a 96.7% RTP. The bonus arrives roughly once every 331 spins. The badge gives the base game a long-term goal, which makes it feel more purposeful than a typical hold-and-win.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus is rare (about 1 in 331 spins on average)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
